SELECT
DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date
CONCAT(YEAR(create_time), '-', WEEK(create_time)) as date
DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') as date
DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date
, SUM(total_amount) as amount, COUNT(order_id) as count FROM dining_hall.orders WHERE status IN ('2005005', '2004005')
AND DATE(create_time) >= #{query.startDate}
AND DATE(create_time) <= #{query.endDate}

SELECT
DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d')
CONCAT(YEAR(create_time), '-', WEEK(create_time))
DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m')
DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d')
as date, SUM(total_amount) as revenue, SUM(total_amount * 0.5) as cost, SUM(total_amount * 0.5) as profit, 50.0 as profitMargin FROM orders WHERE status IN ('2004005', '2005005')
AND DATE(create_time) >= #{query.startDate}
AND DATE(create_time) <= #{query.endDate}
GROUP BY date ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT MIN(o.order_id) as orderId, GROUP_CONCAT(o.order_number) as orderNumber, DATE_FORMAT(o.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as orderTime, SUM(o.total_amount) as totalAmount, GROUP_CONCAT(o.status) as orderStatus, GROUP_CONCAT(d.dish_name) as dishNames, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) as orderCount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id)+SUM(dine.number_of_guests) as customerCount FROM orders o LEFT JOIN dining_hall.order_detail od ON o.order_id = od.order_id LEFT JOIN dining_hall.dish d ON od.dish_id = d.dish_id LEFT JOIN dining_hall.dine_in_orders dine on dine.order_id = o.order_id WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY orderTime DESC LIMIT #{query.pageSize} OFFSET ${(query.pageNum - 1) * query.pageSize}
